source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

parts.target: An **ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED** or **ADEPTUS ASTARTES WALKER** unit of yours that has not been picked to move or charge in the phase.
parts.effect: Whenever one of the unit's models makes a [normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move), [advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move), [fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back) or [Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move), the model can pass horizontally through models (except **TITANIC** models) and through terrain features, for the rest of the phase. As it does, it can cross into enemy models' [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range), but cannot finish a normal move, advance move or fall-back move there.

data.summary:
**When:** [Your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) or [your Charge phase](vsdata:core-rule/charge-phase).

**Target:** An **ADEPTUS ASTARTES MOUNTED** or **ADEPTUS ASTARTES WALKER** unit of yours that has not been picked to move or charge in the phase.

**Effect:** Whenever one of the unit's models makes a [normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move), [advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move), [fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back) or [Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move), the model can pass horizontally through models (except **TITANIC** models) and through terrain features, for the rest of the phase. As it does, it can cross into enemy models' [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range), but cannot finish a normal move, advance move or fall-back move there.
